fields.title: 0. Changes from the Previous Edition
fields.md:
The 13F awaited by the previous edition has arrived. **Among the five large positions (Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet, Bank of America), only Bank of America had a change in share count**, and 3Q trading took place in small and mid-sized positions. Bending Spoons is the only newly named position. Probabilities and assumed value do not move — no rule was satisfied.
